discovery.method: Algebra-owned lexical HTML scan with quote-aware tags and attributes; nonempty text and every non-id attribute are observed. Only exact element selector and property references are reconciled. No equality-based intent inference or ancestor/subtree coverage.
discovery.boundary: This scans the five generated homepage documents, not every corpus destination or live DOM state. Comments, doctype, formatting whitespace and id locator attributes are excluded. Inline script/style bodies and external script/stylesheet dependencies are opaque and remain undecided unless precisely declared. CSS internals, runtime-only states, shadow DOM, frames and semantic/visual fitness are not certified. Token ordinals are byte-rendering evidence addresses, not stable DOM paths.

mechanisms: Existing generic text, record and file ports; native closure, grants and budgets unchanged. Rebase fact reads are cached per invocation; report HTML is compacted while retaining complete JSON evidence.

checks.negative: Undeclared nested copy, links, media, attributes and styles remain undecided; equal values and ancestor declarations cannot classify them; exact property references do not cover other properties. Quoted >, single quotes, empty/boolean and duplicate attributes are retained.

browser.preview: Discovery overview and expanded navigation evidence verified

mobile.expanded: Background-image world evidence and discovered navigation
